target.source: getVirtualChainFromBlockV2 or equivalent node/RPC virtual-chain feed
target.replayGuarantee: Rebuild derived app state from the last trusted blue-score watermark after any rollback.

buildOrder.detail: Define append-only checkpoint and transaction tables.
Read accepted transaction ids and block blue scores from a node/RPC feed.
Reuse the current payload and proof matching rules against stored transactions.
On rollback, mark affected rows stale and rebuild app state from the previous trusted checkpoint.
Expose last checkpoint, lag, rollback status, and mismatch count in the app.

acceptanceCriteria: A replay run can rebuild the same 43 accepted records now covered by the checkpoint and verification commands.
The indexer stores the txid, accepting block blue score, payload bytes, output data, and matched reducer status.
A lower blue-score watermark or missing previous txid blocks derived app state until replay finishes.
Payload app state remains tied to matched accepted payload bytes, not submitted txids alone.
The current public-read checkpoint remains valid evidence while the node/RPC replay backend is not built.
boundaries: This is an implementation plan for durable indexing, not a live node subscription.
It does not change accepted proof, payload, or output-evidence counts.
It keeps local-node setup optional until a durable backend slice is explicitly built.
